{{recipe}}

This '''ginger banana cake''' is made with [[Cookbook:Buckwheat|buckwheat]] flour, making it [[Cookbook:Gluten-Free|gluten-free]]. [http://www.foodista.com/recipe/C5VCLZHX/ginger-banana-cake-with-chocolate Originally posted to Foodista] by Anne Pedersen. Foodista recipes are released under a [http://www.foodista.com/static/legal CC-BY license].

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (135 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Buckwheat|buckwheat]] flour 
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
*¼ cup (60 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]/70 g) [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple syrup]]
*¼ cup (60 ml/65 g) unsweetened [[Cookbook:Applesauce|applesauce]]
*Juice of ½ [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (8 g) grated fresh [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]] 
*3 very ripe [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]] (should have dark spots on the peel)
*¼ cup (30 g) roughly-chopped dark [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] or chocolate chips

==Preparation==
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 170°C (338°F).
#Mix the buckwheat flour, baking powder and baking soda in a bowl, and set aside.
#Mix the maple syrup with the applesauce, the lemon juice, and the grated ginger. Mash the bananas using the back of a fork before mixing them with the other wet ingredients.
#Combine the dry ingredients with the banana mixture. Be careful not to overmix—you don’t want to beat out all of the air.
#Once everything is well-mixed, add the dark chocolate and gently mix again.
#Line a cake pan (20 x 20 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]/ 8 x 8 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]) with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]] and pour the batter into it.
#Place in the oven and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for about 45 minutes or until a [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] inserted in the center comes out clean.

steps.text: Mix the buckwheat flour, baking powder and baking soda in a bowl, and set aside.
Mix the maple syrup with the applesauce, the lemon juice, and the grated ginger. Mash the bananas using the back of a fork before mixing them with the other wet ingredients.
Combine the dry ingredients with the banana mixture. Be careful not to overmix—you don’t want to beat out all of the air.
Once everything is well-mixed, add the dark chocolate and gently mix again.
Line a cake pan (20 x 20 cm/ 8 x 8 inch) with parchment paper and pour the batter into it.
Place in the oven and bake for about 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
